If any ara::diag::SovdServiceValidation::Validate returns an error any contained resource, then the DM shall immediately return an error to the client and not proceed processing the request any further. ⌋ 7.3.3.3 SOVD Data Serialization & Data Conversion The exchange of data from a SOVD Client to a SOVD Server and vice versa takes place on an interpreted physical level, whereas internally (as well as for UDS ISO 14229-1 [1]) the data is expressed by internal data types. The data is defined by DiagnosticSovdContentElement and aggregated by DiagnosticSovd- Content . To express this transformation SwDataDefProps are aggregated by DiagnosticSovdContentElement . This section describes how these transformations shall be interpreted for SOVD and how the subset of a JSON schema that represents a DiagnosticSovdContent shall be derived based on Diagnostic Extract Template[4], so that the Diagnostic Server instance can offer consistent ASAM SOVD [5] [14] [13] APIs. 7.3.3.3.1 SOVD Data – Serialization SOVD data is serialized, using settings from DiagnosticSovdProps.singleEle- mentSerialization . The setting object is supported by this version of the stan- dard. See also chapter Common primitive data types in ISO 17978-3(2026) [13]. 7.3.3.3.2 SOVD Data – Conversion [SWS_DM_01465] SOVD data representation of atomic numeric data Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04256 ⌈ The atomic subset of a SOVD request or response body matching a Diagnos- ticSovdContentElement with DiagnosticSovdPrimitiveContentElement. swDataDefProps with baseTypeEncoding NONE or 2C and a compuMethod of category IDENTICAL , LINEAR , SCALE_LINEAR , RAT_FUNC or SCALE_RAT_FUNC as defined in Diagnostic Extract Template[4] shall be of type integer or number and shall derive the JSON schema properties type , minimum , maximum and mul- tipleOf based on baseTypeEncoding , baseTypeSize , dataConstr and com- puMethod of the corresponding DiagnosticSovdPrimitiveContentElement. swDataDefProps . ⌋ 197 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics
